1.name: VSUP
1.hint: regulator supply; without the on-chip regulator connect VSUP to AVDD or DVDD, whichever is higher

2.name: BASE
2.hint: regulator control output to the base of an external PNP (S8550 in Fig. 1); NC when the regulator is not used; no logic output: the simulation does not model the regulator it drives

3.name: AVDD
3.hint: analog supply; with the regulator VAVDD = VBG × (R1 + R2) / R2, at least 100 mV below VSUP; 10 µF on AVDD in Fig. 1 and Fig. 4

4.name: VFB
4.hint: regulator control input (R1/R2 divider); connect to AGND when the regulator is not used

needs.source: Avia HX711 datasheet V2.0 (LCSC copy, sha256 84834c42…), Power Supply Options: 'If the on-chip analog supply regulator is not used … Pin VFB should be connected to Ground and pin BASE becomes NC'

6.name: VBG
6.hint: reference bypass output, 1.25 V typ; 0.1 µF to AGND with the regulator (Fig. 1), not needed without it; no logic output: the simulation leaves it to its capacitor

needs.source: Avia HX711 datasheet V2.0 (LCSC copy, sha256 84834c42…), Fig. 1 (0.1 µF at VBG) and Power Supply Options: without the regulator 'The external 0.1uF bypass capacitor … at the VBG output pin is then not needed'

11.name: PD_SCK
11.hint: serial clock and power down: high for more than 60 µs powers the chip down; clock high time 0.2–50 µs; 25–27 pulses per conversion select channel and gain

12.name: DOUT
12.hint: serial data output; high = no data ready, low = data ready

13.name: XO
13.hint: crystal I/O; NC when not used

14.name: XI
14.hint: to ground: on-chip oscillator; or a crystal across XI/XO, or an external clock through a 20 pF AC-coupling capacitor

15.name: RATE
15.hint: output data rate: low 10 SPS, high 80 SPS (on-chip oscillator)

16.name: DVDD
16.hint: digital supply; the same supply as the MCU (Power Supply Options)

hints: input common-mode range AGND + 1.2 V … AVDD - 1.3 V (Table 2)
full-scale differential input ±0.5 × AVDD / gain: ±20 mV (gain 128) / ±40 mV (64) at AVDD 5 V; channel B ±80 mV (gain 32)
the reference board (Fig. 4) puts 100 Ω in series with each channel-A input and 0.1 µF across them, and 10 µF on VSUP/DVDD and on AVDD
crystal or external clock 1–20 MHz (11.0592 MHz gives exactly 10/80 SPS)

checked: pinout and pin names = datasheet Table 1 (SOP-16) = EasyEDA symbol
supply ranges DVDD/AVDD 2.6–5.5 V, VSUP 2.7–5.5 V (Table 1)
input common-mode range, VBG 1.25 V, clock 1–20 MHz
regulator, clock and power-down pin use from pages 4–5
2026-10-31: configs regulator and no_regulator from HX711 V2.0, Power Supply Options and Fig. 1: VBG's 0.1 µF only with the regulator, VFB on ground without it

2026-10-31: behaviour logic with icc_a from Table 2 (typical, read now): 1.4 mA analog at VSUP (at AVDD without the regulator), 0.1 mA at DVDD; DOUT state high (p. 4: high while no data is ready); BASE and VBG state off
open: no absolute maximum ratings in the datasheet: vdd_max_v and pin v_max_v not entered
no logic input thresholds (VIH/VIL) and no output levels for PD_SCK, DOUT, RATE, XI
VSUP minimum: Table 1 says 2.7 V, Table 2 says 2.6 V – the pin takes 2.7 V
whether DOUT is push-pull is not stated (treated as a plain output)
the decoupling of VSUP, DVDD and AVDD is only shown in the reference design (10 µF), not specified: the catalog's default applies, the values are in hints
no thermal resistance or junction temperature; no package drawing

open.text: pin 1 of the SOP-16 at the footprint's pin-1 mark

open: icc_a: typical values – the datasheet gives no maximum supply current
the regulator is not modelled: BASE rests off, so with the regulator AVDD has no supply in the simulation – the analog current is drawn at VSUP instead

regulator.about: the on-chip analog supply regulator with an external transistor: AVDD = VBG × (R1 + R2)/R2, at least 100 mV below VSUP; 0.1 µF at VBG (Avia HX711 datasheet V2.0 (LCSC copy, sha256 84834c42…), Fig. 1 and Power Supply Options)

no_regulator.about: no regulator: VSUP to AVDD or DVDD, whichever is higher; VFB on ground, BASE not connected, no capacitor at VBG (Avia HX711 datasheet V2.0 (LCSC copy, sha256 84834c42…), Power Supply Options)
